verdict.rationale: Gmail's own docs describe Gemini in Gmail as a built-in assistant you can hand tasks to. It summarizes threads, drafts and refines emails, proposes meeting times from Calendar, and you can 'ask Gemini' to perform actions such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels. Human account delegation and API or add-on building blocks are not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated actions work reliably, and documentation of multi-step or autonomous task execution beyond the listed examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points. Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
Gemini in Gmail saves you time drafting or polishing emails
